t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Tall hat gnomes gives good rewards, especially blue, pink, and purple. Avoid the red or brown gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: I had the most consistent success picking the blue and purple gnomes. Pink and orange were very hit or miss, but were often also good. I never found any consistent success with red or brown. I don't think the hat sizes mean anything, really. My general advice is to stick with blue and purple gnomes whenever possible, and choose pink if neither of the blue or purple ones appears. Beyond that, I couldn't discern much.
